name: roleboard-prompt-v1
description: Text-only evaluation for Gemini-generated roleboard prompt JSON before downstream image calls.

scale.8: strong production result with minor defects
scale.10: exceptional, specific, clean, and fully supported

dimensions.question: Is the output parseable JSON with exactly the required four keys and no surrounding prose?
Does the prompt preserve every relevant hard fact without converting a design choice into a false story fact?
Does it exclude shot-only pose, emotion, injury, held prop, action, energy, and event state?
Does it request one 16:9 front/profile/back board with equal scale, full body, baseline, spacing, and identity consistency?
Does it separate spatial-template, key-vision-style, and optional same-role-identity responsibilities?
Does it specify concrete face geometry and age evidence that can be verified in pixels?
Does it specify visible and plausible body proportion, posture, and silhouette decisions?
Does it specify functional garment structure, layers, material, palette, wear, footwear, and rear/profile readability?
Does it add only safe stable choices on unconstrained axes with a limited motif and ornament budget?
Does it distinguish the target from the cast without putting other roles into the image?
Are desired pixels stated positively in priority order with only short targeted exclusions?
Is the prompt free of repetition, contradiction, and low-value quality adjectives?
Does the negative prompt cover likely failures without duplicating the positive prompt?

gates.description: Output parses and matches the required schema.
No hard source fact is changed.
No shot-only state enters canonical identity.
No extra view, close-up, panel, label, or conflicting layout.
No conflict with the frozen project rendering medium.
No other named role, creature, or unrequested prop becomes an image subject.
